correctness.rationale: For every k>=1, a five-prefix partition gives a complete disjoint charge indicator: 00* always charges; 100 never; 010 charges only for an alternating prefix through k+2 positions; 101 charges unless the suffix alternates. Exact Fibonacci endpoint counts are checked independently by direct comparison of all four k-mers for 196405 legal contexts, k=1..20. Normalized symmetric Perron eigenvectors (phi,1) give exact stationary cylinder probabilities. The proof uses the exact Fibonacci identity phi^3 F_{k+2}+F_{k-1}=2 phi^{k+2} to establish the theorem for all k. The finite test is not used as infinite certification.

value.rationale: Golden-mean (no-11) sources are a canonical constrained-language model and fixed three-k-mer minimizers are a natural nontrivial sequence sketch. A closed all-k density under non-iid stationary input is directly a sketch-memory/selected-position invariant. Exact even/odd plateau rigidity and the distinction between finite uniform contexts and stationary Parry input are substantive structural information not obtained from a bare implementation or trivial renaming. The theorem makes no ungrounded claims of optimality or downstream genome improvements.
